step_by_step_reasoning:
The whiteboard shows an IoT architecture for a smart garden. 
1. A smart garden device (UserConsumerIOT) sends sensor telemetry (water level, relative humidity, temperature) to AWS IoT Core (IoTCore) and receives state synchronization via Device Shadow.
2. An AWS IoT Topic Rule triggers AWS Lambda on state changes.
3. Lambda fetches plant metadata from a database (DynamoDB) and updates endpoint attributes in Amazon Pinpoint.
4. Amazon Pinpoint sends push notifications to the user's Mobile App (UserConsumerMobile).
5. User feedback/actions from the Mobile App are sent to Amazon API Gateway (ApiGateway), which stores metadata/status updates back into the database (DynamoDB).
